data.name: Musawwir
data.gender_notes: Musawwir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Musawwir is derived from the Arabic root word 'sawwara', which means to create, shape, or form. In Islamic belief, Allah (God) is the ultimate Musawwir, who creates and shapes every living being. The name also symbolizes the ability to shape one's own destiny and character. The name Musawwir carries the meaning “Creator, Shaper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Musawwir usually hope their child will grow to embody creator, shaper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Musawwir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Creator, Shaper.”

The name Musawwir is a source of spiritual guidance and inspiration, reminding us of the importance of living a life of purpose and intention, as Allah has created us to be a reflection of His own perfect creation.
